name: Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years holding PERMANENT residence status specifically (Citizenship Act Article 12) -- not merely 5 years of any residence. Since permanent residence itself requires 5 prior years of long-term/prolonged residence (see bg_permanent_residence.json), the realistic total pipeline from arrival is roughly 10 years.
requirements.fix_path: Hold permanent residence status continuously for 5 years.

requirements.blocker_text: Must be an adult with no convictions for premeditated crimes, have a sufficient income source or occupation, and demonstrate Bulgarian language proficiency.
Applicant must have been released from, or be released from, their previous citizenship as of the moment of acquiring Bulgarian citizenship (Article 12).
Stateless persons may naturalise after 3 years of permanent residence, without the employment/language or prior-citizenship-release conditions of Article 12 (Article 14).
requirements.fix_path: Hold permanent residence status continuously for 3 years.

evidence_required.document: Proof of permanent residence duration matching the applicable category
Proof of release from prior citizenship (standard route only)

sources.title: Bulgaria -- Bulgarian Citizenship Act (official English translation, verbatim primary legislation text), Article 12: standard naturalisation (5 years permanent residence, conduct, income, language, release of prior citizenship); Article 14: stateless persons (3 years permanent residence, exempted conditions)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bulgaria). dual_citizenship_allowed modeled FALSE for the standard route specifically because Article 12 explicitly conditions naturalisation on release from the applicant's prior citizenship -- an unusually strict renunciation requirement compared to most other routes in this dataset, which more commonly allow dual citizenship or are silent on the point. This is a genuine, clearly-stated statutory requirement, not an inference. The source text is a 2002-version translation hosted by GLOBALCIT; treated as tier-1 per this dataset's convention for verbatim-legislation mirrors, though a post-2002 consolidated/amended text was not independently cross-checked for later changes to Articles 12/14 specifically.
